lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Good Samaritan Law & Responsibilities at Crash Scenes
prompt: What is the criminal penalty under Texas law for fleeing the scene of a crash resulting in a fatality?

options.text: Class C misdemeanor settled by paying a five-hundred-dollar traffic ticket
Second-degree felony punishable by 2 to 20 years in prison and fines up to $10,000
Civil administrative penalty involving thirty days community work service
State jail misdemeanor carrying up to forty-five days in county detention
